text: Ena woodani kala mofte, baŋŋe mo ɓe fewtata e mu'n, foti non ko ko memetee walla miijitee; wano luutondiral mofte ka huccitirde maɓɓe e kon ko Allah Shar'inani ɓe, ɗuuɗal yiilorɗe maɓɓe lorrataa so tawii ko yamaruree Allah e shari'a Makko, adondiree -onon gomɗimɓe- e huuwugol moƴƴereeji ɗi yamira-ɗon, Allah mooɓitiroyay on kala nokku mo laatoroyton ñalnde darngal; ngam O yoɓita on golle mo'on. Pellet, Allah ko hattanɗo e dow kala huunde, O Roŋkataa mooɓtude on yoɓa on.
